- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want any of these.

- **Also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.
